design.note: Figma file key. Sync writes only to this file (variables, styles, docs); see docs/design-docs/tool-mapping.md.

ui.note: Visuals and theme variables follow shadcn/ui; the component API speaks spec/api.json (SB-0122); deviations are listed in each contract (realizations.*.drift).

process.note: Contract pair, file layout, Lit mixins, behavior specs, decision log format.

contextBudget.note: What the Claude layer puts in context in every session: CLAUDE.md, rules without paths:, skill and command descriptions, hook output (check H1, SB-0114). Team-owned: raise it only with a reason, and measure the change with docs/research/value-benchmark/scripts/fixed-context.mjs. H1 warns at 90%.

whiteLabel.note: Brand or product names that must never appear in components, stories, tests or contracts (check W1). The visual reference may be named only in contract source lines and drift.

catalog.note: This repo is the source of harness/catalog: G1 keeps the catalog equal to its components (npm run catalog:build). sketchbook init --start keeps it unless --detach-catalog (--yes never detaches); catalog:build is a no-op when source is false (SB-0061, SB-0071).
